title: AB 201 (2021-2022 Wisconsin Legislature, regular session): absentee ballot applications, unsolicited mailing or transmission of absentee ballot applications and absentee ballots, canvassing absentee ballots, electronic voter registration, and providing a penalty.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id) not stated.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id)
(section) s. 6.86 (1) (b) as amended (absentee application)
(quote) Unless the applicant is exempted from providing proof of identification under s. 6.87 (4) (b) 2. or 3., or the applicant is a military elector, the elector shall enclose a copy of his or her proof of identification or any authorized substitute document with his or her application.
(section) s. 6.86 (1) (b) as amended (clerk may not issue ballot without ID copy)
(quote) The clerk shall not issue a ballot to an elector who is required to enclose a copy of proof of identification or an authorized substitute document with his or her application unless the copy is enclosed and the proof is verified by the clerk.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
(other) LRB analysis (printed with the bill): The bill requires the Elections Commission to prescribe the form and instructions of the absentee ballot application.
(other) LRB analysis (printed with the bill): The bill also requires the absentee ballot application to be separate and distinct from the certificate envelope in which voters must seal and submit absentee ballots, the outer portion of which includes certifications of both the voter and a witness.
(other) LRB analysis (printed with the bill): The bill provides that any municipal clerk issuing an absentee ballot without having received a completed application on the form prescribed by the Elections Commission under the bill that contains the voter's original written signature, a copy of the voter's original written signature if transmitted by facsimile transmission, or the voter's electronic signature if submitted in Portable Document Format (PDF) by e-mai
(other) LRB analysis (printed with the bill): The bill eliminates the option for indefinitely confined voters, overseas voters, and all other voters, other than military voters, to receive an absentee ballot automatically for any election.
(other) LRB analysis (printed with the bill): This bill eliminates those three exemptions.
